sources.title: Delhi High Court: Anil Kumar Aggarwal / Jagdish Kumar Arora bail, 9 April 2025
sources.publisher: Delhi High Court, judgment transcribed by CourtKutchehry
sources.summary: Court text sets out the prosecution money trail, the applicants’ objections and conditional bail based on custody and trial delay.
limitations: Full judgment transcription retrieved from a legal mirror; original court-host judgment not retrieved. Procedural bail observations are not a conviction or acquittal. Distinct figures used by opposing parties are not silently reconciled.

sources.title: Bombay High Court: Suraj Satish Chavan bail, 2025:BHC-AS:5193
sources.publisher: Bombay High Court, judgment transcribed by CourtKutchehry
sources.summary: The court records BMC work orders, two primes, subcontractors, alleged diversion and significant counterevidence before granting conditional bail.
limitations: Official Bombay High Court PDF/auth URL returned HTTP 503. Legal mirror text retained. The judgment contains inconsistent date strings and an aggregate/diversion ambiguity; only clearly labeled amounts used. Bail does not establish innocence or guilt.

sources.title: BMC Budget Estimates 2025–26: Municipal Commissioner’s speech
sources.locator: Printed pp 3, 8–10: size of A, B, E, G and Tree Authority budgets, revenue/capital split

sources.title: CAG Delhi Health Report 3/2024, ChapterIV: medicine and equipment procurement
sources.publisher: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
sources.locator: ChapterIV §§4.2.1–4.2.2; §4.2.6.7 Table 4.4 and government reply; recommendation 4.8
sources.summary: Audit identifies procurement shortfalls and four named drug suppliers with historical debarment/blacklisting entries; reproduces the government’s February 2023 reply.
limitations: Official-host indexed excerpts retained; direct full PDF requests returned 503, so this is indexed extraction rather than a downloaded original. Report is numbered 2024 and tabled 28 February 2025; underlying audit 2016–2022, some data through September 2022 and responsesFebruary 2023. Historical restrictions are not current debarment findings or proof of criminal corruption. Table alone does not establish individual payment amount or simultaneous overlap of every purchase with a restriction.

sources.title: Reported BMC special audit: no-tender works and missing agreements
sources.publisher: The Indian Express reporting CAG special audit
sources.locator: 20 works/64 works/13 works paragraphs; audit-period and limitations paragraphs
sources.summary: Reports CAG observations on tender bypass, absent executed agreements and missing independent quality review.
limitations: Original special-audit report and later PAC action-taken report not retrieved. News paraphrase only retained. Cohorts can overlap; work values are not proved losses. Article’s political context is not used to infer individual responsibility.

sources.title: Reported CAG roads/bridges controls and BMC engineer response
sources.publisher: The Indian Express reporting CAG and BMC
sources.locator: Road QMA paragraphs and Chief Engineer’s February 2023 reply
sources.summary: Reports ₹381 crore road payments and delayed quality-monitoring appointment; engineer says departmental sub-engineers supervised and QMA was additional assistance.
limitations: Original audit not retrieved. ₹381 crore is a reported paid amount, not loss or proof that no supervision occurred. QMA absence and absence of all engineering supervision are distinct. No unnamed contractor has been resolved to a named firm.

limitations: Attributed anonymous official response, not an adjudicated reversal. No later PAC disposition retrieved; no current clean-chit or conviction inferred. News body not retained.

records.title: Open tender dataset: notices ≠ awards ≠ payments
records.summary: The mirror exposes separate award and tender-notice schemas. Award metadata can identify a stated winner and contract value; notices alone cannot.
